head: 3a9f705d
headSubject: feat(runtimehost,cli,manager): add npdev db export/import data-mobility tool
summary: Fixed the npdev db export/import feature that shipped last session: made precondition failures (missing jar, no connection, etc.) honor --json instead of crashing the Manager's JSON parser, fixed CsvRowSerializer's CSV NULL-vs-empty-string ambiguity (caused a live NOT NULL constraint failure on flyway_schema_history), and fixed the Manager's byInstaller01 app registry entry which pointed at a never-generated model directory instead of its actual generated FinalApp (byInstaller01-app). Bumped Manager to v0.4.1, added a build-time-stamped version chip (title + auto-timestamp, never hand-typed), and added a new enforced gate check (check-manager-version-bump.py, wired into run-ai-knowledge-gate.ps1 step 51/51) that fails the build if NPDevManager behavior changes without a version bump, after the version was forgotten twice in this session.
nextStep: Nothing is committed yet -- 9 modified files + 1 new file (scripts/quality/check-manager-version-bump.py) sit uncommitted in the working tree, and there is also 1 already-committed but unpushed commit (3a9f705d) from before this session. Review the diff and commit (likely 2-3 logical commits: the CLI/RuntimeHost export-import fixes, the Manager version-bump feature + new gate check), then push. The Manager is running locally (v0.4.1) with the byInstaller01 registry fix already applied to the user's own manager.json outside the repo -- no further action needed there.
verified: runtimehost-core:test (DataExportImportRoundTripH2Test, including new notNullColumnWithEmptyStringRoundTripsAsEmptyStringNotNull case) -- BUILD SUCCESSFUL. Live re-run of the original failing scenario against the running ai-loop-verify-app after restaging the fixed jar -- NOT NULL crash confirmed gone, table verified unchanged/restored to original state. check-manager-version-bump.py manually verified both directions (catches a missing bump, catches a partial bump, passes a correct one). run-script-inventory-check.ps1 -- passed (240/240 classified+invocation-declared). No full run-all-gates.ps1 this session.
